parts.title: TheOneApp Promotional Video 3: The Eclipse Riddle
parts.description:
The light over TheOneApp has gone dark, and a riddle holds the answer. Is it a curse, or a clue? Pip, Momo and Basil find out how light travels. A short adventure from TheOneApp, the science study app for Primary 3 to 6 in Singapore.

Parents: see TheOneApp and try it free for 7 days at https://theoneapp.sg

The only app you need to learn Science: TheOneApp.
